orientation.summary: The actual inventory contains one principal door on +v, the south-facing Cary Street face (outward bearing 172°). The labeled +v render is substantially occluded and does not clearly verify that portal, while no supplied reference view establishes the real entrance face. The nearest-road relationship and postal address are not sufficient evidence; there is no duplicated principal portal in the inventory.

issues.fix: Supply the missing map and labeled SV images, then compare the documented entrance directly with the single rendered +v door; relocate it if another face is evidenced.

issues.problem: Characteristic architectural fidelity cannot be confirmed from model renders alone, so the generic retail-box treatment cannot yet be judged recognizable.
